name: 文件與書報
summary: 信、單據、護照、雜誌這一類會拿到或寫的文字。

sentences.en: Please fill in this form and give it to the office.
sentences.zh: 請填寫這張表格，然後交給櫃檯。

sentences.en: I bought a new magazine at the station this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我在車站買了一本新雜誌。

sentences.en: My passport expires next year, so I need a new one.
sentences.zh: 我的護照明年到期，所以需要換一本新的。

sentences.en: She left a short message on my desk before lunch.
sentences.zh: 午飯前她在我的桌上留了一則留言。

sentences.en: The article in this newspaper is about healthy food.
sentences.zh: 這份報紙上的那篇文章在談健康飲食。

sentences.en: We need a menu and two tickets for the show.
sentences.zh: 我們需要一份菜單和兩張演出的票。

sentences.en: I bought this notebook for my English class.
sentences.zh: 我買了這本筆記本要用在英文課上。

sentences.en: Can you send me the photo by email tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你明天可以用電子郵件把照片寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: Please write your name clearly on this card.
sentences.zh: 請在這張卡片上把名字寫清楚。

sentences.en: I read the comic before I started my homework.
sentences.zh: 開始寫作業之前我先看了一本漫畫。

sentences.en: The teacher gave our class a new project.
sentences.zh: 老師給我們班一個新的專題作業。

sentences.en: We have a big exam at the end of the term.
sentences.zh: 這學期末我們有一場大考試。

sentences.en: He read the whole book in just three days.
sentences.zh: 他只花了三天就讀完整本書。

sentences.en: My driving licence ends in March, so I must renew it.
sentences.zh: 我的駕照三月到期，所以我必須換照。

tips: 這組有些字以 /t/ 結尾，例如 ticket、text，末尾的音別漏掉；bill、postcard 則分別以 /l/、/d/ 結尾，不要記成一樣。
這組字很多以 t 結尾，例如 bill、ticket、text、postcard，末尾的音別漏掉。
打完一遍要回頭檢查會不會漏字，diary、magazine 這種長單字最容易少打一個字母。

name: 學校教育
summary: 學校生活：科目、課本、考試、教室裡的用品。

phrases.en: look up a word in a dictionary
phrases.ipa: ˌlʊk ʌp ə ˈwɜːd ɪn ə ˈdɪk.ʃən.ri

phrases.en: borrow a book from the library
phrases.ipa: ˌbɒ.rəʊ ə ˈbʊk frəm ðə ˈlaɪ.brə.ri

sentences.en: My son goes to school by bus every morning.
sentences.zh: 我兒子每天早上搭公車上學。

sentences.en: We have four lessons in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我們上午有四堂課。

sentences.en: She always does her homework after dinner.
sentences.zh: 她總是吃完晚餐後才做家庭作業。

sentences.en: The maths exam was really difficult this year.
sentences.zh: 今年的數學考試真的很難。

sentences.en: Our teacher writes new words on the blackboard.
sentences.zh: 我們的老師把新單字寫在黑板上。

sentences.en: I need a new eraser and a ruler.
sentences.zh: 我需要一塊新的橡皮擦和一把尺。

sentences.en: He studies science and history at university.
sentences.zh: 他在大學念科學和歷史。

sentences.en: This word is difficult so I checked my dictionary.
sentences.zh: 這個單字很難，所以我查了字典。

sentences.en: We must finish the project before Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們必須在星期五之前完成專題作業。

sentences.en: My classmate gave me his history notes.
sentences.zh: 我的同學把歷史筆記借給我。

sentences.en: Can you explain this lesson again, please?
sentences.zh: 請你再解釋一次這堂課好嗎？

sentences.en: Every student must work hard in class.
sentences.zh: 每個學生在課堂上都必須努力。

sentences.en: She speaks three languages at school.
sentences.zh: 她在學校會說三種語言。

sentences.en: Our term starts in September and ends in July.
sentences.zh: 我們的學期九月開始、七月結束。

tips: 先打出整個句子，再回頭檢查大小寫和標點，句號是最容易忘記的一個。
homework 這種合字中間沒有空格，dictionary 這種多音節字要跟著音節分節奏。
每天固定背五個新單字，隔天先複習昨天的，再學新的，效果最好。
